AGENDA

  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE

340 Palos Verdes Drive West  July 9, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

Upon request, the agenda can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a
disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk’s
office at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification
or accommodation.

The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
July 22, 2014. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the Council with
their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask the
Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item from the
Consent Calendar for discussion.

CALL TO ORDER

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety
Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda
unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on July 22, 2014.

ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  July 9, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CEREMONIAL MATTERS
   Swearing-in of New Committee Member Caroline Leach
   Acknowledgment of New Vice-Chair Kenneth Kao

ROLL CALL  Committee Members King, Leach, Vice-Chair Kao, and Chairman Buss present.
  Committee Member Beall absent.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 None

OLD BUSINESS
1. None.

NEW BUSINESS
2. Palos Verdes Drive West and Yarmouth Road Yield Control Modification.

  Action: Traffic Safety Committee Vice-Chair Kao moved (seconded by Traffic Safety
  Committee member King) to recommend that Staff: 1) Replace the existing “YIELD” sign
  with a larger sign; and, 2) Install a yield line on the merging lane from eastbound Yarmouth
  Road onto Palos Verdes Drive West as determined by the City Traffic Engineer. The vote
  was 4 in favor (Beall absent).

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, July 22, 2014.

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Planning & Building Director JR for SR
Action Memo
July 9, 2014
 3. Palos Verdes Drive West and Paseo Del Mar Parking Lot Traffic Control Modification.

  Action: Traffic Safety Committee Vice-Chair Kao moved (seconded by Traffic Safety
  Committee member King) to recommend that Staff: 1) Install and upgrade signage and
  markings in the parking lot and southbound slip lane between Palos Verdes Drive West and
  Paseo Del Mar as recommended by the City Traffic Engineer; 2) Install a new “YIELD” sign
  and yield line in the slip lane; and 3) Install a new “Cross Traffic Does Not Stop” warning
  sign for traffic exiting the parking lot. The vote was 4 in favor (Beall absent).

RESIDENT LETTERS
4. Stop control request at Via Chino and Via Media – Norman Eagle.

  No further action.

5. Stop control request at Via Coronel and Via Zurita – Zachary Bazilius.

  Action: Traffic Safety Committee member King moved (seconded by Traffic Safety
  Committee member Leach) to recommend that Staff review traffic conditions and develop
  recommendations after school begins. The vote was 4 in favor (Beall absent).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE

6. June 24, 2014 City Council Action Minutes.
   Item 12 (a) – Palos Verdes Drive West Install Additional Speed Limit Signs and Markings
   Item 12 (b) – Palos Verdes Drive West Upper Barrel Modify Striping and Markings

7. Staff Items of Information for the Committee.
   Information for Members of the Traffic Safety Committee – Policy Acknowledgments
   City of Torrance Street Resurfacing on Palos Verdes Boulevard Update
   Traffic Control Plan Preparation for Special Events and Maintenance Activities
   PVE 75th Anniversary Traffic Control Plan Update
   FY 14/15 Street Resurfacing Program Update

ADJOURNMENT TO SEPTEMBER 10, 2014.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, July 22, 2014.
